name: Azure Translator
label: Azure Translator
description: Official Azure Translator REST api-version=2026-06-06 (GA, not backward compatible with v3.0) on INPUT input → OUTPUT output. Remaining operations: translate (POST /translate) and transliterate (POST /transliterate). Detect, dictionary lookup/examples, and breaksentence were removed in 2026-06-06 — detect → Azure AI Language; dictionary → adaptive custom translation. Auth is StudioQuack secret subscription_key as Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key. Optional region → Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Region. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/translator/text-translation/how-to/migrate-to-2026-06-06. Legal: https://azure.microsoft.com/support/legal/. Never log subscription_key. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. translate requires body `inputs` (official array of {text, language?, targets:[{language}]}). transliterate requires query language + fromScript + toScript and body `inputs`. Do not put subscription_key here. v3.0 query `to` / array [{Text}] are gone.

schema.label: inputs
schema.description: Official Translator JSON array. translate: [{"text":"Hello","targets":["es"]}]. transliterate: [{"text":"こんにちは","language":"ja","fromScript":"Jpan","toScript":"Latn"}].

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (Translator JSON array). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official Translator 2026-06-06 verb. EXACT: translate | transliterate. Default translate = POST /translate?api-version=2026-06-06. detect and dictionary_lookup were removed in this version.

configurationParameters.label: Subscription Key
configurationParameters.description: Azure Translator / Foundry key. Sent as Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key. StudioQuack secret only. Never logged. Empty → error 'subscription_key is required'.

configurationParameters.label: Region
configurationParameters.description: Resource region for multi-service / regional keys (e.g. westeurope). Sent as Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Region when set; omitted when blank. Global Translator resources can leave this empty.

configurationParameters.label: Inputs
configurationParameters.description: Official Translator JSON array. translate: [{"text":"Hello","targets":["es"]}]. transliterate: [{"text":"こんにちは","language":"ja","fromScript":"Jpan","toScript":"Latn"}].
